nom: Biore Deep Pore Charcoal Face Wash For Oily Skin

segments.oily: Most reviewers with oily skin report reduced shine and fewer breakouts with regular use, though a minority, including one who developed a painful rash and chemical burns after three days and another whose extremely oily skin turned unexpectedly dry, react badly and have to cut back to weekly use or stop altogether.
segments.dry: A reviewer with very dry, extremely sensitive skin reports it is too drying for daily use but works well two to three times a week once eased into slowly, alongside general cleansing satisfaction.
segments.combination: Combination-skin reviewers, including one with hormonal acne, report the wash controls oily areas like the forehead and nose without stripping drier areas such as the cheeks, with visible reduction in blackheads and acne over time.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers are split: some report it turns their face red or is too harsh for daily use, while others, including one who calls her skin very sensitive, report no reaction at all and recommend pairing it with a moisturizer.
segments.normal: One reviewer with fairly normal skin reports it works fantastically with no issues, while noting from other reviews' photos that a subset of users may be having an allergic-type reaction.

concerns.dehydration: Many reviewers, including some with oily skin, find the cleanser drying with frequent use and cut back to two or three times a week or follow with a moisturizer; others, including some using it daily, report it does not leave skin feeling dry or tight.
concerns.redness: A small number of reviewers report severe reactions -- a painful swollen rash, chemical burns, or skin splitting at the corners of the mouth -- strong enough that one calls it unbearable after three days; many more, including several with sensitive skin, report no redness or irritation, describing a tingling or minty sensation as normal rather than a problem.
concerns.blemishes: The large majority of reviewers, including several managing hormonal or adult acne, report fewer breakouts and reduced blackheads within weeks to a few months; one reviewer specifies it helps only with light acne and would not recommend it for severe acne.
concerns.oiliness: The large majority of reviewers with oily skin report visibly reduced shine and oil through the day without residue; one reviewer with extremely oily skin nonetheless found it unexpectedly drying and cut back to once a week.

aspects.libelle: Frequently arrives damaged, leaking or with a broken pump
Large bottle, a little goes a long way
Thick gel texture that lathers well
Some question authenticity or receive a different formula than pictured
Strong scent that some find overpowering

extraits.titre: PLEASE DO NOT BUY THIS PRODUCT.
extraits.texte: Why does this have 4 stars?!?! Though I bought this from Walmart, I wanted to also review it on amazon to tell people, DO NOT BUY THIS PRODUCT. I used this 3 nights ago, read the instructions which were pretty basic, for my oily skin. The first night my face kind of stung but I said wow, my face is soft and yeah it stings a bit but it’s probably because it’s very clean. The next morning I woke up to a red, painful, swollen rash everywhere I applied the product. You would think that it’d still better overtime but it is now day three with this painful bumpy face and it BURNS even more now. The skin around the corners of my lips are splitting whenever I talk or smile, I have chemical burns on my cheeks, and every couple of hours my skin flares into a red stinging burning mess. Everywhere where I didnt apply this foul product is completely fine. My cheeks, nose, and chin haven’t been able to make any new oils, as my skin is splitting from the dryness. The only thing that soothes it is coconut oil during work hours, and cold compresses during the night. I honestly don’t know how the hell this is still on the market. It’s been a very painful experience and all I can hope is that my skin doesn’t stay this bumpy forever. Thanks for the chemical burns biore. BTW the pictures are taken with coconut oil and Vaseline covering my skin. This is the only way I can get through the day with only minor splitting. Mind you again, this is the THIRD a day after initial use. Ridiculous.

extraits.titre: I've been using it for a month
extraits.texte: It feels like it really lifts away dirt and leaves my skin feeling very fresh, but even though I have oily skin, both products leave an extremely tight feeling. With continued use, my skin feels drier than usual. The cleanser has a light, easy-to-spread consistency, and the mask dries quickly without feeling heavy. It yields quite a lot, since a small amount is enough. The cleanser has a minty feel that may be uncomfortable if you have sensitive skin. It may be best to use it only a couple of times a week rather than daily. For someone with more balanced or sensitive skin, it may be too harsh.

Ok the thing about face cleansers like this is that they work or the don’t work, depending on the type of persons skin. I don’t really have sensitive skin, as I try any type of face wash reguarlily. Like others I bought this face wash because of the charcoal fad going on. I have tried charcoal scrubs, masks, and pore strips for blackheads. When I first put this cleanser on my face, it was apparently burning. Like others I thought if it burns then it probably is removing all the gross dirt and oils. So I was scared of what would happen. Not much bad happened to me other than really dry skin which is weird for me because I have extremely oily skin. I use it once a week and use the Mario Badescu rosewater spray to help with any drying and redness. This routine works great. Just know your skin and do what’s best for it.

extraits.titre: This has been great for an annoying skin condition I have struggled with for years....
extraits.texte: I picked this up on a whim when I was purchasing a new package of Biore pore strips--I had never tried any of the other products in this line, but several coupons popped up and the price of this item and a couple of others seemed so good, that I just had to try them. I have very dry skin, but it is also extremely sensitive, so I have to be careful with new products. I think I finally have the dryness under control with a whole arsenal of serums and moisturizers, but I'm still trying to find the best cleanser (or combination of cleansers) for my face. I have enlarged pores on my nose and chin and I also have that slightly dimpled skin = peau d'orange on my chin which seems to be tied to blocked glands just under the surface. I have never been able to do anything about that and just figured I was stuck with it (and I've tried dozens and dozens of products from different brands and at many price points). I was concerned about the experiences some reviewers have had regarding rashes and breakouts, so I eased into using this slowly--tried it on my forearms first, and then just a small region of my face...never any problem, so I finally worked up to using this two or three times per week. It is a little too drying for me to use it every day. I've been using this cleanser for a couple of months and I like it a lot; my skin feels very clean and fresh after using it. extraits.titre: Oil control, Reduced pore size, Non stripping
extraits.texte: Hands down the best face wash. Been using this wash for over a year now. Have it on auto buy so I never run out. Nice light minty smell that tingles when you use it. Controls oil without over stripping your face. Luckily I have never struggled with pimples or blackheads but I do have very fair combo skin. This wash controls my oily forehead and nose but doesn't strip my dry cheeks. Three people in my house ran out of their wash and used my Biore. They loved it and all three now buy their own bottle. One does struggle with pimples and blackheads. After approx three months of use she says she has noticed a good 50% reduction of pimples and her blackheads have substantially decreased in pore size. Nothing can totally erase your pores but this wash definitely does clean them out which then decreases their size. That alone is worth giving this wash a try.

I have tried so many face washes. I have (what I assume to be) hormonal acne. I’m 48 and it’s super annoying. I have very much combination skin and couldn’t get the oily parts controlled without drying out the rest. This has been amazing and my acne is finally going away.

extraits.titre: My favorite face wash! Love the tingle
extraits.texte: I use this face wash every day in the shower and it is my absolute favorite that I've ever tried. It gives you this amazing little tingle in your face and when you rinse it off your skin feels so refreshed and almost "minty" is the word that comes to mind. It also has this unexplainable smell that my wife and I both love and cannot find in any other product, must be a biore trade secret or something. I have never really had any problems with acne so I cannot speak to whether this helps with that one way or the other, but I can definitely say it did not cause me to start getting any acne as I have seen some people have experienced. All in all, absolutely love the way it makes me feel, smell and look! NOTE: reading many of the other folks reviews on here, I have a strong suspicion that there is a chemical in the face wash that some people are severely allergic too. Many of the pictures I see in the other reviews appear to be allergic reactions (my wife is a dermatologist for Aveda, and she agrees). My advice would be give it a try and see what you're experience is, I have fairly normal Italian olive-tone skin and it works fantastic for me, however if you have sensitive skin it might be worth trying it on a small area first to see how you react instead of slathering it all over your face the first time. I try to review products that I use often and have very extensive experience with because I know how much I rely on other people's reviews and opinions when I make my purchases.
